description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act Notification Under Section 30
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka establishing the Market Rate of Interest under the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act. It constitutes a regulatory determination made under statutory authority, specifically referencing Section 30 of Act No. 02 of 1990. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves the implementation and enforcement of existing legislation through regulatory action.
